name: 作成者と責任者の変更記録にコメントできる目標の活動欄
prompt:
Create one high-fidelity Japanese localization of the activity-and-comment component shown in the supplied reference crop, as a clean product UI screenshot.

Match the reference's exact wide, short composition and quiet Asana-like admin styling: very light neutral gray panel, subtle horizontal divider, small circular user avatars on the left, compact activity text above, then a large white comment field with a thin pale-gray border and rounded corners. Keep generous horizontal width and compact vertical height. The component should fill a 4.37:1 frame with no surrounding page chrome, no extra whitespace, no shadows, no decorative graphics, no other sections.

Use the Japanese mock as the localization and identity guide. Show exactly these two activity entries, each with the same name and time format: 「山田 花子が目標を作成しました · たった今」 and 「山田 花子があなたを責任者にしました · たった今」. The first activity entry has the bolded name; keep the remaining text medium-gray. Place the second activity directly below and indented to align with the activity text, as in the original.

Below a fine horizontal separator, show a small circular avatar at left and a large white bordered multiline comment field to its right. Its only text is the placeholder 「質問やコメントを入力…」 in muted gray, aligned near the upper-left inside the field. Use the exact Japanese copy with crisp, correctly rendered glyphs.

Preserve the reference avatar portrait appearance and relative placement as closely as possible; do not add people or icons. The supplied Japanese mock shows a mint-green circular avatar with 「山」; follow that mock's simple mint avatar treatment. Do not invent additional buttons, activity events, comments, labels, or controls.

No English text. No page header or description. Render as a flat, sharp, realistic web-app component screenshot with faithful alignment and small readable UI typography.
reviewNotes: Japanese activity and comment content is present, but the 2170x725 canvas is 2.99:1 versus the 1168x267 source crop at 4.37:1, with large white bands above and below the component. Exact avatar pixels and typography are unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
